scholarships.title: University of Bologna Study Grants and Subsidies

existing.description: The University of Bologna's study grants and subsidies portfolio helps students continue their studies regardless of financial situation. It includes tuition fee reductions based on financial situation or merit, offered by the regional body ERGO, a total merit-based fee exemption for students in the first year of second cycle degree programmes, ER.GO study grants, grants for students experiencing difficulties, and accommodation and rent support in university halls of residence in the Region. It also signposts national schemes run by the Ministry of Universities and Research, the Ministry of the Interior and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for international protection holders, international students and students from conflict-affected countries.
eligibility: Enrolled at the University of Bologna on a degree programme
Financial situation or merit, as assessed under the relevant ERGO or ER.GO scheme
Personal, family or economic difficulty, for grants aimed at students experiencing difficulties
International protection status, for MUR and Ministry of the Interior schemes
Nationality or residence abroad, for MAECI scholarships for international students
Personal circumstances, for scholarships for students from countries where access to university is prevented or severely limited
existing.eligibility_summary: Eligibility is set per scheme. The portfolio covers needs-based and merit-based tuition fee reductions administered by ERGO, a total merit-based exemption for first-year second cycle students, ER.GO study grants, grants for students experiencing difficulties, university hall of residence accommodation and rent grants, MUR and Ministry of the Interior scholarships for international protection holders, and MAECI scholarships for international students.
benefits: Tuition fee reduction based on financial situation or merit
Total merit-based fee exemption for first-year second cycle degree students
ER.GO study grants and associated services
Place in a university hall of residence in the Region
Access to MUR, Ministry of the Interior and MAECI scholarship competitions
coverage: Reduction in tuition fees based on financial situation or merit
Total merit-based exemption from fees for first-year second cycle students
Study grants from ERGO and ER.GO
Accommodation in university halls of residence in the Region
Grants covering part of the cost of rent
documents: Documents specified by each individual call and by ERGO or ER.GO for the relevant benefit
existing.notes: ERGO is the Regional Authority for the Right to Higher Education for the Emilia-Romagna region and administers the fee reductions and grants. MUR and the Ministry of the Interior schemes run in partnership with CRUI, and the MAECI scholarships are administered by the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation. The University also refers to its official notice board at bandi.unibo.it for live calls and competitions.
existing.application_period: Rolling portfolio of calls; the September call is the stated convention for grants for students experiencing difficulties, and awards are granted throughout the year.
existing.deadline_display: The official page publishes no single deadline. It states "The call for applications is usually published in September" for grants for students experiencing difficulties, and "Scholarships and awards are granted throughout the year."
existing.program_type: University study grants and fee subsidy portfolio
